lines.text: We're going bowling tonight. Are you down?

data.define: Used to say you agree to a plan or want to do it.

example.text: We're going bowling tonight. Are you down?

misuse.text: Don't say 'I'm down' when you feel sad.
misuse.why: It can also mean feeling low.

data.l1_hook: Tối nay đi bowling, ai đi nào?
data.l1_ex: Tối nay đi bowling nè. Bạn có down không?

native.tip: “I'm down” = Tui chơi, tui đồng ý. Ví dụ: “We're going bowling tonight. Are you down?”
